_comment: Sample config for hamshack.py. Copy this file to hamshack.json (same
directory as the script) and edit it for your station. hamshack.json is
git-ignored because it is station-specific.
dli_host        : hostname or IP of your Digital Loggers web power switch.
Credentials come from your .netrc (curl --digest --netrc),
NOT this file. Add: machine <dli_host> login <user> password <pw>.
verify_timeout  : max seconds to wait for an outlet's physical_state to match.
verify_interval : seconds between physical_state polls.
sequence        : ordered list of steps, walked top-to-bottom on power-up
and in reverse on power-down. Two step types:
{ "type": "dli", "outlet": N, "name": "..." }
outlet is the RELATIVE (0-based) outlet number = physical outlet - 1.
{ "type": "command", "name": "...", "on": <cmd>, "off": <cmd>,
"retry_timeout": 0.0, "retry_interval": 3.0 }
<cmd> is either a string (run via the shell, for PATH lookup like k4up)
or a list of tokens (run directly, no shell). Placeholders {python} and
{here} expand to the interpreter and this script's directory.
retry_timeout > 0 re-runs the command until it succeeds or the window
elapses (useful when a device needs time to boot after its outlet powers on).
Keys beginning with an underscore (like this one) are ignored.
